result: AdmitCore, AdmitReflect, AdmitInterpret, and AdmitImport compile under Lean 4.35.0. Every printed axiom list is empty, hence inside {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}.
proof_boundary: The receipt records that these four modules type-check and that their #print axioms lines report no axioms. It does not change any DAG node. Quotation is a syntax inverse and a transport of Step, not a truth predicate. Import records do not feed Holds. S(n), MSS-N, and the rules and requirements fields stay open imports. Conservativity is proved only for the IdRefl(2) conjunction in AdmitInterpret.id_conservative.

lean_replay.library: AdmitLang (lean_lib in lean4/lakefile.lean; not a default target)
lean_replay.build_directory: lean4/b (lakefile buildDir; removed after the run)
lean_replay.dependency_packages: read-only junction lean4/.lake/packages to the shared Mathlib v4.35.0 cache (removed after the run)
lean_replay.command: cd lean4 && lake build <Module>   (one invocation per module, in the order AdmitCore, AdmitReflect, AdmitInterpret, AdmitImport)
